name: jengo/base
description: Core package of the Jengo framework. Integrates Vite, Dependency Injection container, dynamic Macros & Mixins, static & fluent Model Facades, robust event triggers, validation form handlers, JSON entities with Sqids obfuscation, dynamic module autoloading, fluent array/string wrappers, bidirectional data mapping, Pest database testing, and modern developer ergonomics.

models.description: Entity representing standard schemas. Uses MacroableTrait for dynamic runtime extension, provides JsonSerializable control via visible/hidden arrays, and Sqids-based integer ID obfuscation.

properties.visible: array of property names allowed during JSON serialization
properties.hidden: array of property names stripped during JSON serialization
properties.obfuscatedFields: array of integer ID properties (e.g. ['id', 'user_id']) to encode/decode using Sqids

models.usage: class UserEntity extends BaseEntity { protected array $obfuscatedFields = ['id']; protected array $hidden = ['password']; }

macros.description: Enables dynamic method injection, closure binding ($this), static macros, and mixins on any class.
macros.discovery: app/Config/Macros.php and modules/*/Config/Macros.php via MacroDiscovery and Config\Modules::$aliases

methods.macro: macro(string $name, object|callable $macro): void (Registers a single dynamic method)
methods.mixin: mixin(object|string $mixin, bool $replace = true): void (Registers all public methods returning Closure from a mixin class)

container.description: PSR-11 compatible Dependency Injection container supporting autowiring, singleton binding, contextual binding, method injection, and tagged services.

helpers.inject: inject(callable|array|string $target): Closure (wraps route actions with automatic DI parameter resolution)

methods.bind: bind(string $abstract, Closure|string|null $concrete = null, bool $shared = false): void

facades.description: Allows fluent and static querying over standard CI4 models, supporting findOrFail, firstOrFail, when, unless, tap, and pipe.

methods.findOrFail: findOrFail(mixed $id): array|object (finds record by primary key or throws PageNotFoundException)
methods.firstOrFail: firstOrFail(): array|object (finds first matched record or throws PageNotFoundException)
methods.when: when(mixed $value, callable $callback, ?callable $default = null): static (applies callback if value is truthy)
methods.unless: unless(mixed $value, callable $callback, ?callable $default = null): static (applies callback if value is falsy)
methods.tap: tap(callable $callback): static (executes callback passing the model facade instance)
methods.pipe: pipe(callable $callback): mixed (pipes the model facade instance to a callback and returns the result)

facades.description: Static facade providing type-safe inputs, validation, and request inspection.

methods.all: all(): array (returns merged GET, POST, and JSON body parameters)
methods.input: input(?string $key = null, mixed $default = null): mixed (retrieves single input or all inputs)
methods.boolean: boolean(string $key, bool $default = false): bool (casts input to boolean: 1/0, true/false, 'yes'/'no', 'on')
methods.integer: integer(string $key, int $default = 0): int (casts input to integer)
methods.float: float(string $key, float $default = 0.0): float (casts input to float)
methods.date: date(string $key, ?string $format = null, ?string $timezone = null): ?CodeIgniter\I18n\Time (casts input to Time instance)
methods.bearerToken: bearerToken(): ?string (retrieves Bearer token from Authorization header)
methods.only: only(array $keys): array (retrieves only specified input keys)
methods.except: except(array $keys): array (retrieves all inputs except specified keys)
methods.has: has(string|array $keys): bool (checks if input keys are present)
methods.filled: filled(string|array $keys): bool (checks if input keys are present and not empty)
methods.missing: missing(string|array $keys): bool (checks if input keys are missing)
methods.validate: validate(array $rules, bool $redirect = true): bool|array (runs validation rules, redirects back with errors on failure or returns error array)

mapping.description: High-performance bidirectional entity and DTO mapper powered by PHP 8 attributes.

attributes.description: Maps target property from a different source key or nested dot-notation path.
Class-level attribute configuring the default source class and mapping behavior.
Specifies nested entity or collection hydration types for property transformation.

validation.description: Abstract class to define validation rules, custom messages, handle redirect/JSON responses, automatic Sqids deobfuscation, and fetch validated data.

properties.messages: array of custom validation error messages
properties.obfuscatedFields: array of fields to automatically deobfuscate using Sqids unhashing prior to running validation
properties.routeParams: map of input keys to route parameter indices (e.g. ['id' => 0]) to fetch and deobfuscate parameters from matched route URLs

methods.validate: validate(?RequestInterface $request = null): bool (clears validation cache and runs validation)
methods.validated: validated(): ValidatedData (returns the ValidatedData DTO containing categorized validation results)

validation.description: DTO containing validated inputs separated by transport source as stdClass objects to prevent key collision.

methods.get: get(?string $key = null, mixed $default = null): mixed (returns the GET stdClass object or specific field)
methods.post: post(?string $key = null, mixed $default = null): mixed (returns the POST stdClass object or specific field)
methods.json: json(?string $key = null, mixed $default = null): mixed (returns the JSON body stdClass object or specific field)
methods.router: router(?string $key = null, mixed $default = null): mixed (returns the Router parameters stdClass object or specific field)
methods.any: any(string $key, mixed $default = null): mixed (retrieves input from router, json, post, or get sequentially)
methods.toArray: toArray(): array (compiles a flat key-value array of all validated inputs)

validation.description: Transport object passed to the jengo.form.failed event, allowing listeners to override the validation failure response.

methods.getResponse: getResponse(): ?ResponseInterface (returns the overridden response if set)

validation.description: Controller class or method Attribute targeting pre-dispatch validation handling using a FormHandler.

events.name: jengo.form.failed
events.description: Triggered when a FormHandler validation fails. Receives a FormFailedResponseHolder to let other adapters like Inertia JS influence the response.
Base event structure. Enforces event name constant (NAME) and handler method.
events.usage:
class OrderCreated extends AbstractEvent { public const NAME = 'order.created'; public static function event(...$args): void { /* handle event */ } }
trigger_event(OrderCreated::class, $order);

libraries.description: Fluent wrapper for array manipulation, supporting conditionals, pipes, wrapping, and transformations.

methods.wrap: Arr::wrap(mixed $value): array (wraps value in an array if not null and not already an array)

libraries.description: Fluent wrapper for string manipulation, slugging, random generators, casing, search, and conditional pipeline.
Discovers and loads app/Config/Macros.php on boot and searches modules/*/Config/Macros.php and packages when Config\Modules::$aliases has 'macros'.

modules.description: Scans root modules/ directory recursively to find Jengo modules containing a Module.php marker, registering their PSR-4 namespaces on the CodeIgniter autoloader dynamically or from cache.

methods.discoverAndRegister: discoverAndRegister(): void (boots and registers modules namespaces)
methods.discover: discover(): array (gets cached or live scanned list of module namespaces)

testing.description: Fluent Pest database test configuration builder eliminating beforeEach database boilerplate.
